title: Hunts FH-013: Implement draft editor and preview

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 1, Creator. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Add optimistic draft commands, private preview, graph validation and immutable publish. Done when: Two tabs cannot overwrite a newer revision and preview creates no real progress. Requires: FH-005, FH-007, FH-008, FH-012. Owner role: Web.
